description: Finish signing up with the code from the email, or with the sign-in link copied from it unopened. Returns the person's API key, shown once, and how to connect with it. Save the key in the MCP connection's settings as the Authorization header, then reconnect to get the full set of tools.

code.description: The code from the email, or the whole sign-in link copied from the email without opening it

email.description: The same email given to register
